description_en: Queries the list of patches for a cloud application
description_zh: 查询一个云应用的Patch列表
kebab_example: aliyun vs list-cloud-app-patches --app-id cap-b06b26edfhytbn_b94a75ae1a79efc90eb --patch-name patch-1 --patch-id patch-03fa76e8e13a49b6a966b063d9d309b4 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --start-time 2015-11-29T00:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCloudAppPatches

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud application. This ID corresponds to a unique application package
parameters.help_zh: 云应用ID，对应唯一的应用包
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the patch package
parameters.name: patch_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the patch package
parameters.name: patch_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the list to return. The value starts from 1.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值为100行。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The time range for filtering. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 standard format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
PageSize.title_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。

Patches.description_en: The list of cloud application patches

items.description_en: The information about the cloud application patch

PatchId.description_en: The ID of the patch package

PatchName.description_en: The name of the patch package

Status.description_en:
The upload status of the application. Valid values:

Created

Doing

Success: A final state.

Failed: A final state.

Deleting

DeleteFailed: A final state
Status.description_zh:
应用上传状态，取值范围：
Created
Doing
Success：终态
Failed：终态
Deleting
DeleteFailed：终态
Status.title_zh:
应用上传状态，取值范围：
1. Created
2. Doing
3. Success：终态
4. Failed：终态
5. Deleting
6. DeleteFailed：终态

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the status was last updated

UploadTime.description_en: The time when the patch was uploaded
